text.p: Thyssen Handelsunion AG, trade and services unit of Thyssen AG, said on Thursday it expected to post a clearly improved result in the current business year.
The company said stringent cost management and vigorous internationalization will help it overcome continued recessionary developments.

Thyssen Handelsunion is hoping to rebound from "one of the most difficut business years in our history." Its pretax profit dropped to a mere 1.2 million marks in the year ended September 30 from 227 million marks the year before.

Group income from ordinary activities fell to 42.4 million marks from 227 million marks, but results were further hammered by extraordinary outlays of 41.2 million marks, mainly for restructuring its recyling business in east Germany, versus nil the year before.
The company blamed higher materials costs, difficult market conditions, sluggishness in the construction sector and start-up costs in telecommunications for the poor results.
